item.title: Hokkaido Hidden Gems: Shakotan Blue Coast, Tomamu Ice Village & Beyond
item.description: Hokkaido’s tourist circuit — Sapporo, Otaru, Hakodate, Niseko, Furano — is genuinely excellent. But the island is the size of Austria, and the tourist circuit covers perhaps 5% of its geography. The remaining 95% includes a peninsula with water colour found only in the Mediterranean and Okinawa, an ice hotel that is rebuilt entirely every winter in a mountain valley, a bankrupt city that reinvented itself around a single piece of fruit, and Japan’s most underrated industrial night view.
